methodology.transport: loopback HTTP/1.1, identity encoding; warm processes/connections, fresh materialized state
methodology.addedRTT: selected cases inject a fixed delay before each HTTP request; not a network emulator
methodology.latencyIncludes: HTTP, body transfer, JSON decode, digest verification, hydrate, fold, raw-input recovery
methodology.latencyExcludes: fixture setup, warmup, oracle assertions, publication, process startup, claim and handler execution
methodology.cpuCaveat: client thread CPU excludes oracle assertions but excludes other V8/native threads; whole-client CPU includes assertions; process counters include pressure writer when active
methodology.counterCaveat: server CPU has process-counter resolution; Redis commands include INFO and Lua subcommands; before/after RSS is not peak memory
methodology.pressure: 4 readers plus 50 events per 50ms on a separate source; each phase at least 3s; actual achieved rate and scheduling lag are recorded
methodology.workload: synthetic State-shaped changes; not Electric SDK/EntityStreamDB or production traces
methodology.ordering: alternating full/snapshot then snapshot/full by round
